resources.string: Step 1 of 2 · Set up the Eden folder
SwitchForge needs access to the Eden folder to install cheats.
This way the app shows the games you have installed in Eden first.

1. Set up the Eden folder (the app guides you).
2. Tap Scan: your installed games show up in My Games.
3. Tap a game, tick the cheats and tap Install.
4. Open the game in Eden and enable the cheats in Properties > Add-ons.

Tip: use search to find a game by name or Title ID, and Active Cheats to turn on, turn off or remove what you have installed.
